item.title: IDB head working on $2.5 billion Venezuela loan, faces board pushback, sources say
item.description: The head of the Inter-American Development Bank has been working to secure approval for a $2.5 billion loan for Venezuela but has faced pushback from some at the lender's board, two sources with knowledge of the matter told Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Rodrigo Campos, Cassandra Garrison
item.content:encoded: The head of the Inter-American Development Bank has been working to secure approval for a $2.5 billion loan for Venezuela but has faced pushback from some at the lender's board, two sources with knowledge of the matter told Reuters. IDB President Ilan Goldfajn has faced concern from the board about pursuing the lending to Caracas without the typical parallel work of other multilateral lenders, even though the board recognizes the benefits of reengaging with Venezuela, one of the sources said. The IDB stopped making new loans to the South American country in May 2018 after it fell behind on payments.

item.title: Flexible Jacks benefitting from new England role with bat and ball
item.description: Will Jacks has embraced a new position down the batting order that has also seen him take on a more influential role with the ball following career-best One Day International figures of 5-22 in England’s 89-run win over Sri Lanka on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Will Jacks has embraced a new position down the batting order that has also seen him take on a more influential role with the ball following career-best One Day International figures of 5-22 in England’s [USN:L6N45E0YW TEXT:"89-run win over Sri Lanka"] on Tuesday. When Jacks first came into the ODI side in 2023, he mostly batted in the top three and was bowled sparingly, but as England look ahead to the 2027 Cricket World Cup in South Africa, Zimbabwe and Namibia, his role is evolving. His first 15 ODIs batting mostly higher up the order saw him average 31.20 with the bat and 45.00 with the ball. But since dropping down the order to number 6 or 7, in the last 12 matches he has played his batting average has risen to 42.83 and his bowling average dropped to 34.60. He was a match-winner against Sri Lanka with his five-wicket haul and an unbeaten 46 with the bat, earning praise from captain Harry Brook. "The way he has come into this role in the middle order and played his part with the ball has been awesome," Brook told Sky Sports. Jacks could be particularly well suited to the conditions at next year’s World Cup, having played with success for several seasons in South Africa’s SA20, giving him an understanding of white-ball conditions there. "It is about playing the situation and going into each game with an open mind, see what the situation is and play accordingly," Jacks said. "What we have been doing really well recently is communicating what the pitch is like and what sort of score we would like. Joe and Harry were saying ... 275-280 would be a good score. "When I got out there (to bat), I found it quite difficult and thought it might be a bit lower, but in 50-over cricket you have more time than you think and we could catch up a little bit in the end." Jacks has also previously been used in the opening overs of a bowling innings, but on this occasion came later on. "Having batted on it, I knew I would play a decent role (with the ball). When I bowl does not matter to me, Harry likes to be flexible," he said. The second match in the three-game series will be played in Leeds on Thursday.

item.title: Fala de Lula sobre “pobre morrer cortando cana” era crítica à falta de acesso à educação
item.description: Publicações nas redes sociais tiram de contexto uma fala do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva para afirmar que ele disse que “pobre tinha que morrer cortando cana”.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Publicações nas redes sociais tiram de contexto uma fala do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva para afirmar que ele disse que “pobre tinha que morrer cortando cana”. As postagens , que circulam no Facebook, no Instagram e no Threads, omitem que o trecho fazia parte de uma crítica a uma elite que, segundo Lula, historicamente não investiu em educação para a parcela mais pobre da população brasileira. "A nossa primeira universidade só foi criada 420 anos depois que Cabral chegou aqui, porque a elite brasileira daquela época não queria educar os indígenas... Eles não se importavam, porque os filhos deles iam estudar na Europa, estudar nos Estados Unidos, e o pobre tinha que morrer cortando cana ou garimpando para eles”, disse Lula. O vídeo completo do discurso, realizado em Teresina no último dia 9, está disponível no canal do presidente no YouTube . Lula já fez comentários similares anteriormente, que também foram alvo de desinformação . VEREDICTO Enganoso. A fala de Lula sobre pobre ter que "morrer cortando cana" faz parte de um discurso mais amplo sobre falta de acesso à educação. Este artigo foi produzido pela equipe da Reuters Fact Check. item.title: In UN farewell, Macron denounces Trump's Gaza diplomacy as spectacle of shame
item.description: France's President Emmanuel Macron on Tuesday dismissed US President Donald Trump's claims of having secured peace in Gaza, saying not a single humanitarian corridor had been reopened in the enclave despite the proclaimed peace.
item.dc:creator: John Irish
item.content:encoded: France's President Emmanuel Macron on Tuesday dismissed US President Donald Trump's claims of having secured peace in Gaza, saying not a single humanitarian corridor had been reopened in the enclave despite the proclaimed peace. In his final address to the United Nations before leaving office next year, Macron said the world was witnessing a spectacle that should shame everyone, rebuking Trump's portrayal of his Gaza peace plan as a diplomatic triumph. He spoke at the United Nations General Assembly hours after Trump had from the same rostrum hailed his Gaza peace plan as a diplomatic triumph. "A year ago, here in this very hall, about a dozen states had recognized Palestine. I hear the cynicism of some people: 'Recognition is just a piece of paper, look at the reality,'" Macron said, banging his fist on the podium in his last speech at the United Nations before stepping down next May. "But what credibility do we have if we continue to remain inactive in the face of Gaza? Some boast of a supposed peace. But that peace has not reopened humanitarian access for a single second. Are we simply to stand by and watch this spectacle that should shame us all?" The White House did not immediately respond to a request for comment. "One year ago, when I addressed the great leaders in this hall, the war in Gaza was still raging brutally," Trump said in his earlier speech. "A few weeks later, we ended the war in Gaza, saving untold thousands of lives." Macron has faced criticism among some politicians and activists in France that he has done little since recognising a Palestinian state last September. Despite the criticism, Paris has toughened its stance on settler violence against Palestinians in the West Bank, imposing some national sanctions and launching a process to ban products from Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank. "Look at what is happening in the West Bank, where every day violations are committed. In whose name? Hamas has never operated in the West Bank," Macron said. "What is happening there is building, day by day, the impossibility of a project that should be based on respect for the legitimate right of the Palestinian people to exist." France's ties with Israel have been particularly strained over the last year. Macron said those who believed that violating the sovereignty of all of Israel's neighbors would ensure its security were mistaken. "They are weakening Israel's security, both today and in the future," he said. 'LONG LIVE THE UNITED NATIONS' Seven months from France's next presidential election, Macron was making his last appearance after first taking to the rostrum in 2017. Often showing a keen eye for the trappings of diplomacy — the grand settings, the symbolism, the personal connections — he has at the same time failed to translate this into lasting strategic gains, analysts say. However, he has always been a staunch defender of the multilateral system and the United Nations. Macron warned against a global "return to the law of the jungle", saying countries faced a choice between a world governed by power and coercion and a "civilized international society." "Our duty, more than ever, is to stand alongside the United Nations. We cannot accept the new order of impunity that some would like to build," he said. He ended his speech with "Long Live the United Nations!"

item.title: Nasdaq tem fechamento recorde; ações do setor de IA registram alta
item.description: O Nasdaq registrou um fechamento recorde nesta terça-feira, impulsionado pela Micron Technology e outras ações relacionadas à IA, enquanto o S&P 500 ficou um pouco abaixo de sua máxima histórica, com os preços do petróleo oscilando em torno de US$100 por barril.
item.dc:creator: Noel Randewich, Johann Cherian
item.content:encoded: O Nasdaq registrou um fechamento recorde nesta terça-feira, impulsionado pela Micron Technology e outras ações relacionadas à IA, enquanto o S&P 500 ficou um pouco abaixo de sua máxima histórica, com os preços do petróleo oscilando em torno de US$100 por barril. As ações do setor de chips ampliaram os ganhos recentes, enquanto as ações de software voltadas para o consumidor perderam terreno. Os investidores se concentraram na forte recepção do assistente de IA da Meta, lançado neste mês e capaz de enviar emails e realizar transações em nome do usuário. O sucesso do assistente de IA, chamado Muse, impulsionou os ganhos das ações de chips relacionadas à IA nos últimos dias. No entanto, alguns temiam que ele pudesse competir com varejistas, corretoras online e outras empresas do setor de consumo. A Amazon (AMZN.O) bloqueou, na segunda-feira, o acesso do assistente para compras em sua plataforma. “Há muitas ações do setor de tecnologia em baixa hoje devido a receios relacionados ao Muse, de um tipo ou de outro”, disse Jed Ellerbroek, gestor de portfólio da Argent Capital Management. “As pessoas temem que o Muse seja usado para gerenciar seus contratos de seguro, reservar suas viagens e procurar coisas para comprar.” Os aplicativos de transporte Uber Technologies (UBER.N) e Lyft (LYFT.O) perderam terreno, enquanto a Expedia (EXPE.O) e a Charles Schwab (SCHW.N) também registraram quedas. As fabricantes de chips de memória Micron (MU.O) e SanDisk (SNDK.O) registraram alta. De acordo com dados preliminares, o S&P 500 (.SPX) teve variação negativa de 0,01%, fechando em 7.764,27 pontos, enquanto o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) ganhou 0,45%, para 27.243,24 pontos. O Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) caiu 0,36%, para 51.863,89 pontos.

item.title: Microsoft to give DARPA hands-on access to quantum system at new Maryland site
item.description: Microsoft on Tuesday said it will give the US Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency direct, on-site access to its latest quantum computing hardware as part of a new research center the company opened in Maryland alongside the University of Maryland and other industry partners.
item.dc:creator: Stephen Nellis
item.content:encoded: Microsoft (MSFT.O) on Tuesday said it will give the US Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency direct, on-site access to its latest quantum computing hardware as part of a new research center the company opened in Maryland alongside the University of Maryland and other industry partners. The center, located in the university's Discovery District near Washington, D.C., will house a new quantum system that uses [USN:L6N4291A0 TEXT:"Microsoft's Majorana 2 chip"] for independent testing and evaluation by DARPA. Quantum computers hold the promise of tackling problems that would take conventional machines thousands of years. Of particular [USN:L1N42U0V1 TEXT:"interest to national security experts"] is protecting and cracking encrypted communications. Microsoft is one of a number of quantum firms being evaluated by DARPA to discover whether any quantum computing approach can yield economically feasible systems by 2033. Until now, DARPA has evaluated Microsoft's technology remotely, accessing machines in Redmond, Washington, and Europe. The Maryland delivery marks a shift to physical access in a dedicated DARPA space where its experts can load hardware and run it through their own boot sequences. "This is a big deal for us because it essentially enables DARPA to kick the tires and to sort of figure out how good this machine is and how it's performing," Zulfi Alam, corporate vice president of Microsoft Quantum, said in an interview. Alam said the arrangement imposes discipline as Microsoft moves from research toward a commercial product. DARPA's key evaluation metric is whether the value of the computation performed by a quantum system outweighs the system's cost. "It enforces a certain amount of engineering rigor that scientific teams normally do not have," he said, describing DARPA as "a completely trusted organization" with which Microsoft can share both current work and future plans. Alam said DARPA will start with the Majorana 2 chip, but that the system in Maryland will be built to swap in future chips Microsoft is developing. Microsoft has said it plans to have commercial quantum systems ready by 2029.

item.title: Microsoft to keep shareholder proposal rights through 2027, even as SEC reduces oversight
item.description: Microsoft will consider shareholder proposals at its annual meetings through next year, at the request of an activist looking to preserve investor rights as they come under pressure from a contentious U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission rule change proposed last week.
item.dc:creator: Ross Kerber
item.content:encoded: Microsoft (MSFT.O) will consider shareholder proposals at its annual meetings through next year, at the request of an activist looking to preserve investor rights as they come under pressure from a contentious U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission [USN:L1N4580J4 TEXT:"rule change proposed last week"]. Under an agreement with conservative activist Paul Chesser, seen by Reuters, Microsoft will continue to apply existing thresholds for investors to submit resolutions for a vote, even as the SEC considers changes that critics say would sideline individual investors, religious groups, unions and others who have had a say through the shareholder proposal process for decades. The agreement only lasts a year, but could effectively offset efforts by the regulatory agency to shift power away from investors to corporate executives. Chesser said he hopes Microsoft's approach will become a corporate-governance model to assure mom-and-pop investors a voice that can be followed by other companies. "Microsoft put in writing that the smallest long-term owners of the company will still have a way to be heard next year, no matter what the SEC does," said Chesser, director at the National Legal and Policy Center. "Every other company that claims to value its shareholders should be asked why it won't do the same," he said. In an e-mailed statement, a Microsoft spokesperson said: "With the Securities and Exchange Commission announcing that its shareholder proposal regulatory framework is under review, we agreed to maintain the current eligibility thresholds for one year, providing Microsoft and its shareholders a clear and predictable process for the next proxy cycle." Shareholder resolutions on topics like climate change, workforce diversity and executive pay have become the focus of many shareholder meetings in recent years, although many have received [USN:L1N3T70QY TEXT:"diminishing support"] from major fund firms. EARLY EXAMPLE Microsoft's meeting is set for December 8 and traditionally has been held early in the proxy cycle that runs through June 30 of each year, bringing attention to the company's governance procedures. Last week SEC Chair Paul Atkins, an appointee of US President Donald Trump, proposed to end the agency's oversight of the resolutions process and [USN:L1N4580J4 TEXT:"move the function to state officials"], which activists saw as a shift that would diminish their influence. The move is part of a broader [USN:L1N3P40X7 TEXT:"shift of power"] away from investors toward managers by the Republican-dominated commission. The agreement between Chesser and Microsoft, seen by Reuters, says Microsoft will continue to apply previous eligibility requirements for investors to submit resolutions for a vote. Chesser's group has similar resolutions pending with Procter & Gamble and Oracle (ORCL.N) and may submit more. P&G's annual meeting is set for October 13. In its proxy statement dated August 28, the company recommended votes against the proposal, among other things calling it premature since the SEC hadn't yet proposed its rulemaking. A P&G representative declined to comment. Oracle's AGM has not yet been set. A representative did not immediately respond to questions.

item.title: Dólar sube en volátil sesión los inversores evalúan perspectivas sobre inflación
item.description: El dólar subió el martes en una sesión irregular, oscilando entre ganancias y pérdidas tras haber alcanzado previamente un máximo de dos meses, porque la volatilidad de los precios del petróleo enturbiaba el panorama de la inflación.
item.dc:creator: Chuck Mikolajczak
item.content:encoded: El dólar subió el martes en una sesión irregular, oscilando entre ganancias y pérdidas tras haber alcanzado previamente un máximo de dos meses, porque la volatilidad de los precios del petróleo enturbiaba el panorama de la inflación. * Los precios del petróleo bajaron alrededor de un 1%, retrocediendo desde máximos previos, luego de que el presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, dijo a periodistas en las Naciones Unidas que funcionarios estadounidenses habían mantenido una reunión "muy buena" de tres horas el martes con la delegación iraní. * Los precios del crudo habían caído previamente a un mínimo de dos semanas tras la propuesta de Irán de reabrir el estrecho de Ormuz en un plazo de siete días si Estados Unidos reducía la presión militar, y después de que Teherán y Washington insinuaron la posibilidad de reactivar las negociaciones para poner fin a su conflicto. * Sin embargo, el optimismo inicial se vio mermado cuando Trump dijo, en un discurso ante la Asamblea General de la ONU, que creía que Estados Unidos llegaría a un acuerdo con Irán tras las elecciones legislativas de principios de noviembre; esto impulsó tanto al precio del petróleo como al dólar. * El índice dólar , que mide la divisa estadounidense frente a una cesta de monedas, subió un 0,17%, a 100,59 puntos, mientras que el euro cayó un 0,18%, a 1,1441 dólares. Durante la jornada, el índice dólar llegó a subir un 0,29%, a 100,70 puntos, su nivel más alto desde el 30 de julio, aunque también anotó caídas de hasta el 0,11%. * El conflicto en curso entre Estados Unidos e Israel contra Irán ha impulsado los precios del petróleo y avivado la preocupación por la inflación, lo que llevó a varios bancos centrales, incluida la Reserva Federal, a subir las tasas de interés en los últimos días; no obstante, el reciente optimismo sobre un posible acuerdo ha hecho que los precios del crudo vuelvan a situarse por debajo de los 100 dólares por barril. * Los comentarios de funcionarios de la Fed tras la decisión de política monetaria también han señalado la posibilidad de nuevas alzas si la inflación no se desacelera. * Frente al yen , el dólar se fortaleció un 0,03%, a 157,41 yenes, en su tercera ganancia diaria consecutiva. La libra esterlina se depreció un 0,23%, a 1,3332 dólares, a su segunda caída diaria seguida y la sexta en los últimos siete días.

item.title: Reino Unido se mantendrá firme sobre Malvinas, dice el primer ministro Burnham a Trump
item.description: El primer ministro británico, Andy Burnham, expuso el martes la posición de su país sobre las Islas Malvinas durante una reunión con el presidente estadounidense, Donald Trump, en la que sostuvo que se mantendría firme ante cualquier amenaza.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El primer ministro británico, Andy Burnham, expuso el martes la posición de su país sobre las Islas Malvinas durante una reunión con el presidente estadounidense, Donald Trump, en la que sostuvo que se mantendría firme ante cualquier amenaza. En agosto, Trump declaró que estaba revisando la postura neutral de Estados Unidos sobre el archipiélago del Atlántico Sur. Días después, el presidente argentino, Javier Milei, anunció que sancionaría a las compañías petroleras que perforaran en las islas. "Nuestra postura es clara: nos mantendremos firmes ante cualquier amenaza. Defenderemos el derecho de los habitantes de las Islas Malvinas a la autodeterminación y a seguir siendo británicos", declaró Burnham a periodistas. "Solo quería que el presidente supiera directamente de mí cuál es la postura británica y él entendió perfectamente lo que le estaba diciendo", agregó.

item.title: Britain will stand firm over Falklands, UK PM Burnham tells Trump
item.description: Prime Minister Andy Burnham set out Britain's position on the Falkland Islands during a meeting with US President Donald Trump on Tuesday, saying he would stand firm in the face of any threats.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Prime Minister Andy Burnham set out Britain's position on the Falkland Islands during a meeting with US President Donald Trump on Tuesday, saying he would stand firm in the face of any threats. In August, Trump said he was reviewing the United States' neutral position on the remote archipelago in the South Atlantic. Days later Argentine President Javier Milei said he would sanction oil companies drilling in the islands. "The clear position is: we will stand firm in the face of any threats. We will defend the right of the Falkland Islanders to self-determination and to remain British," Burnham told reporters. "I just wanted the president to know directly from me, that's the clear British position, and he very much understood what I was saying."

item.title: Pirates reinstate Kirby Yates from IL, DFA Camilo Doval
item.description: The Pittsburgh Pirates swapped one former All-Star closer for another Tuesday when Kirby Yates was activated from the injured list and fellow right-hander Camilo Doval was designated for assignment.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Pittsburgh Pirates swapped one former All-Star closer for another Tuesday when Kirby Yates was activated from the injured list and fellow right-hander Camilo Doval was designated for assignment. Yates, 39, has appeared in a combined 44 games for the Pirates and Los Angeles Angels this season and has three saves while going 2-5 with a 3.40 ERA. The two-time All-Star saved as many as 41 games for the San Diego Padres in 2019 and has 101 career saves over 12 seasons with a 3.36 ERA for eight different clubs. Yates last pitched on Aug. 30 because of a right shoulder impingement. Doval, 29, is 3-2 with a 4.30 ERA in 64 combined relief appearances this season for the New York Yankees and Pirates. The one-time All-Star saved as many as 39 games for the San Francisco Giants in 2023 and has 109 career saves over six seasons. Yates was acquired in an Aug. 3 trade from the Angels, two days after Doval was acquired in a deal from the Yankees. --Field Level Media

item.title: Report: Bears QB Tyson Bagent in concussion protocol
item.description: The Chicago Bears' quarterback concerns deepened Tuesday with starter Caleb Williams dealing with a hamstring injury and backup Tyson Bagent entering concussion protocol, NFL Network reported.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Chicago Bears' quarterback concerns deepened Tuesday with starter Caleb Williams dealing with a hamstring injury and backup Tyson Bagent entering concussion protocol, NFL Network reported. Williams has not been ruled out to play Monday against the Philadelphia Eagles after he was injured on a fourth-quarter scramble near the goal line this past weekend. He is currently listed as "week-to-week" by head coach Ben Johnson. If Bagent and Williams are unable to play against the Eagles, Chicago's third-string quarterback is 38-year-old Case Keenum, who has not played in a game since 2023 and has made just four starts since 2020. Williams, who guided the Bears to the NFC Divisional Round of the playoffs last season, was 15-of-26 passing for 138 yards and an interception Sunday, with 42 rushing yards despite being sacked three times. Bagent took over and went 5-of-9 passing for 54 yards. Chicago fell 9-3 at home to the Minnesota Vikings and dropped to 1-1 on the season after scoring 59 points in a Week 1 victory over the Carolina Panthers. --Field Level Media

item.title: Jacks takes five and hits unbeaten 46 as England crush Sri Lanka
item.description: Will Jacks took a career best 5-22 and scored an unbeaten 46 to guide England to an 89-run victory over Sri Lanka in the first One Day International at Chester-le-Street on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Will Jacks took a career best 5-22 and scored an unbeaten 46 to guide England to an 89-run victory over Sri Lanka in the first One Day International at Chester-le-Street on Tuesday. After electing to bat, England posted 265 all out in 48.1 overs, before Sri Lanka limped their way to 176 all out in 37 overs in reply as the home side continued their good recent run in the format ahead of next year’s Cricket World Cup in South Africa, Zimbabwe and Namibia. England have won five of their last six ODI fixtures, a run that also includes two victories over Sri Lanka in Colombo in January. "It wasn’t the easiest of surfaces but we want to be a team that can adapt to conditions and get a win when they are not in our favour and I thought we did that very well today," England captain Harry Brook told Sky Sports. "Jacks is an outstanding player and has been for many years now. The way he has come into this role in the middle order and played his part with the ball has been awesome." Their innings was given impetus by Brook’s 67 from 69 balls before he holed out at deep cover. Jacks struck a fine unbeaten 46 from 47 balls, while Joe Root was bowled by debutant leg-spinner Sachindu Colombage for 44 from 52 deliveries. Colombage, 28, picked up 3-44 in his 10 overs with Jos Buttler (31) another of his victims in a promising debut. The wicket was a little slow, which made stroke-play more challenging, as England's last five wickets added 69 runs after 300 had seemed on the cards at one point. Seamer Asitha Fernando managed some swing and took 3-53 in his 9.1 overs. Captain Kusal Mendis scored 42 from 60 balls but Sri Lanka could not stem the flow of wickets and, just as they have throughout the tour, struggled to form partnerships. Dunith Wellalage hit a brisk 45 from 36 deliveries but was one of three wickets for spinner Jacks in a single over to end the game. "The bowlers did really well in the first innings, but our middle order was struggling a little when we were batting. We have to try and create something more special in the middle order and had to score more boundaries earlier (in the innings),” Sri Lanka captain Kusal Mendis said. The second match in the series will be played in Leeds on Thursday, before a final clash at The Oval on Sunday.

item.title: McDonald's defeats most of Black franchisees' sweeping race bias lawsuit
item.description: A US judge in Chicago has significantly narrowed a sprawling lawsuit accusing McDonald's of pervasive discrimination against Black franchise owners, finding that the case was overstuffed with claims that were vague or untimely.
item.dc:creator: Daniel Wiessner
item.content:encoded: A US judge in Chicago has significantly narrowed a sprawling lawsuit accusing McDonald's of pervasive discrimination against Black franchise owners, finding that the case was overstuffed with claims that were vague or untimely. US District Judge Steven Seeger in a 125-page decision on Monday said the scope of the lawsuit, which was filed in 2023 by 48 McDonald's franchisees, pushed the bounds of what is allowed under federal litigation rules. Seeger said the lawsuit's core allegations that McDonald's exhibited a pattern of [USN:L1N3150XV TEXT:"setting up Black franchisees to fail"] could only be brought in a class action, and not by individual plaintiffs aggregating their claims. But even a class action would likely falter, the judge said, because each plaintiff's circumstances were considerably different. The lawsuit, Seeger wrote, "is reminiscent of the old game of seeing how many people can fit in a phone booth. At some point, you hit a wall, and stuffing anything more into one space becomes completely impracticable." Seeger also dismissed retaliation claims, finding the plaintiffs had not alleged that they engaged in protected conduct such as filing complaints with government agencies, and said that dozens of fraud and tortious interference claims were time-barred. A small number of the claims will proceed, primarily focused on whether McDonald's violated franchise agreements by denying the plaintiffs access to benefits such as rent relief that were extended to other franchise owners. McDonald's, in a statement provided by a spokesperson, said the ruling affirmed the company's position that the lawsuit lacked merit. “McDonald's provides robust resources to ensure our franchisees can succeed; our success is tied to their success," the company said. Steve Art, a lawyer for the plaintiffs, declined to comment until his clients had a chance to review the ruling. Until last year, McDonald's was represented in the case by former US Attorney General Loretta Lynch, who served under Democratic former President Barack Obama, and others at law firm Paul Weiss. McDonald's is now represented by Chicago-based Riley Safer Holmes & Cancila and its managing partner, Patricia Holmes. Lynch had also represented McDonald's in [USN:L1N30R1VG TEXT:"a lawsuit by the media entrepreneur Byron Allen"] accusing the fast-food chain of intentionally excluding Black-owned media from much of its advertising budget. McDonald's [USN:L1N3SG10D TEXT:"settled the case"] last year on confidential terms, and denied wrongdoing. There are three lawsuits pending before Seeger that collectively involve 80 franchisees accusing McDonald's of a decades-long pattern of race discrimination. They claim McDonald's deliberately steered Black franchisees to purchase underperforming restaurants in predominantly Black areas with high crime rates while denying them opportunities in affluent, more profitable areas. McDonald's also offered Black franchise owners less operational support, imposed harsher demands, and obstructed their business expansion efforts, the plaintiffs claim. Monday's ruling largely tracked a March decision by Seeger in a separate lawsuit brought by a single Black franchisee. The case is Manning v. McDonald's, US District Court for the Northern District of Illinois, No. 1:23-cv-00210. item.title: Yankees hold off Rays' celebration with win in doubleheader opener
item.description: Cody Bellinger hit a two-run home run in the fourth inning as the host New York Yankees recorded a 2-0 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays in the opener of a day-night doubleheader on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Cody Bellinger hit a two-run home run in the fourth inning as the host New York Yankees recorded a 2-0 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays in the opener of a day-night doubleheader on Tuesday. With the victory, the Yankees (90-66) prevented the Rays (95-61) from clinching the AL East and moved six games ahead of the Boston Red Sox for the American League's top wild-card spot. Tampa Bay still has a magic number of two to clinch the fifth divisional title in team history and first since 2021. New York's Carlos Rodon (7-3) scattered three singles over eight innings as the Yankees finished off the victory in a brisk 2 hours, 2 minutes. Rays right-hander Nick Martinez (15-5) allowed two runs on five hits over six innings with seven strikeouts to take his first loss since July 9. Rodon allowed singles to Chandler Simpson in the second, Victor Mesa Jr. in the sixth and Jonathan Aranda in the seventh. The left-hander struck out eight in his 100th career win and longest outing since he went eight innings against the Chicago Cubs on July 11, 2025. Rodon also reached 1,500 strikeouts when he set down Jonny DeLuca on a slider in the eighth. Martinez retired the first nine Yankees hitters of the game before Ben Rice laced a double to right field to lead off the fourth inning and Bellinger hammered the next pitch to the right-field seats for a 2-0 lead. It was Bellinger's 17th home run and sixth in his past 26 games. Bellinger also started a key double play from left field to end the sixth. After Mesa opened the inning with a single, Richie Palacios lofted a fly ball to left with Bellinger making the catch then firing a one-hop throw to first baseman Luis Garcia Jr. to complete the double play. It was Bellinger's eighth outfield assist of the season. David Bednar finished New York's 15th shutout by retiring Yandy Diaz for his 35th save. --Field Level Media

item.title: Ukraine's Zelenskiy says he discussed peace efforts, energy ceasefire with Trump
item.description: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said on Tuesday that he discussed an energy ceasefire and how to end the war with Russia during his meeting with U.S. President Donald Trump.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said on Tuesday that he discussed an energy ceasefire and how to end the war with Russia during his meeting with U.S. President Donald Trump. Talking to the media after a 40-minute meeting with Trump and his team, Zelenskiy said that Kyiv was ready for any format of the energy ceasefire with Russia, but there had been no discussion of Ukraine unilaterally halting its attacks on Russian refineries. Zelenskiy reiterated that he was ready to meet Russian President Vladimir Putin at a trilateral meeting with Trump, adding that he hoped that the U.S. would find a way to bring Moscow to any kind of negotiations.

item.title: Hackers do ShinyHunters dizem ter invadido sistemas do FBI
item.description: O grupo de extorsão digital conhecido como “ShinyHunters” anunciou nesta terça-feira ter invadido sistemas da polícia federal dos Estados Unidos, o FBI, alegando ter roubado dados de milhares de funcionários do órgão.
item.dc:creator: Raphael Satter, A.J. Vicens
item.content:encoded: O grupo de extorsão digital conhecido como “ShinyHunters” anunciou nesta terça-feira ter invadido sistemas da polícia federal dos Estados Unidos, o FBI, alegando ter roubado dados de milhares de funcionários do órgão. O FBI não respondeu imediatamente a pedidos de comentários feitos pela Reuters. O ShinyHunters afirmou em um comunicado publicado em seu site na dark web, e durante um bate-papo online com a Reuters, que teve o FBI como alvo em resposta a um comunicado do órgão de maio deste ano que detalhou os métodos do grupo de hackers e aconselhava os alvos a não pagarem as exigências. O grupo compartilhou o que alegou ser uma captura de tela de um site de vagas do FBI vandalizado e o que descreveu como uma amostra dos dados roubados. A Reuters não conseguiu verificar a autenticidade da captura de tela, mas uma mensagem publicada no site de vagas do FBI nesta terça-feira informava que o site e o “Portal de Candidatos a Agente Especial” do FBI estavam ambos “indisponíveis no momento”. A Reuters conseguiu verificar parcialmente a autenticidade de algumas das informações supostamente roubadas do quadro de funcionários do FBI, comparando os nomes e endereços postais com registros de agências de crédito e dados de violações anteriores preservados pela empresa de inteligência da dark web District 4 Labs. Em pelo menos nove casos, a Reuters encontrou uma correspondência. No entanto, a agência de notícias não conseguiu determinar de onde os dados vieram, nem se eles foram roubados dos sistemas internos do FBI, como alegam os hackers.

item.title: Grande furacão Polo ganha força na costa do Pacífico do México
item.description: O furacão Polo, que na manhã desta terça-feira atingiu a categoria 5 -- a mais alta possível --, continuou se intensificando na costa do Pacífico do México, representando riscos de inundações potencialmente fatais, informou o Centro Nacional de Furacões (NHC, na sigla em inglês) dos EUA.
item.dc:creator: Aida Pelaez-fernandez, Raul Cortes
item.content:encoded: O furacão Polo, que na manhã desta terça-feira atingiu a categoria 5 -- a mais alta possível --, continuou se intensificando na costa do Pacífico do México, representando riscos de inundações potencialmente fatais, informou o Centro Nacional de Furacões (NHC, na sigla em inglês) dos EUA. Apesar da proximidade e das fortes chuvas que trará, a expectativa é que Polo se desloque lentamente ao largo da costa nos próximos dois dias e mude sua trajetória, afastando-se ainda mais da costa, acrescentou um comunicado do NHC. “Espera-se uma mudança de rumo para noroeste e oeste-noroeste ainda nesta noite e na quarta-feira”, alertou o NHC. “Na trajetória prevista, o centro do Polo deverá ficar próximo à costa do sudoeste do México nos próximos dias, embora a previsão seja de que ele permaneça no mar.” Com ventos máximos sustentados próximos a 270 km/h, é provável que haja um fortalecimento adicional até a noite desta terça-feira. Uma aeronave “Hurricane Hunter” da Administração Oceânica e Atmosférica Nacional (NOAA) está a caminho para investigar o Polo, acrescentou o boletim. O Polo, classificado pelo NHC como “extremamente perigoso”, está atualmente localizado a cerca de 335 km ao sul da cidade turística de Zihuatanejo. Há expectativa de que as chuvas nos Estados costeiros de Guerrero e Michoacán provoquem inundações e deslizamentos de terra considerados de alto risco, enquanto chuvas menos prejudiciais também são esperadas nas regiões costeiras dos Estados de Oaxaca, Colima e Jalisco, informou o NHC. Autoridades mexicanas alertaram para a previsão de chuvas intensas nas regiões oeste e sul do país, que podem causar transbordamentos de rios. A empresa privada de previsão meteorológica AccuWeather observou que o alcance da tempestade pode se estender a destinos turísticos como Acapulco e Puerto Vallarta, enquanto o sul da Baja California Sur, incluindo a região de Los Cabos, também pode enfrentar ondas de tempestade e fortes rajadas de vento até domingo. Posteriormente, a tempestade poderá seguir mais para o interior e em direção aos EUA, mas será influenciada pela interação com a tempestade tropical Odalys, o que poderá manter o furacão mais distante da costa e limitar a chegada da umidade tropical ao sudoeste dos EUA. Os ventos fortes e as chuvas do Polo também devem atingir Lázaro Cárdenas e Manzanillo, principais portos do país. “Até o momento, as informações que temos indicam que não atingirá diretamente a costa; ele contornará... especialmente os Estados de Jalisco, Colima e Michoacán. E peço a todos ao longo da costa do Pacífico que permaneçam muito atentos”, disse a presidente Claudia Sheinbaum durante sua coletiva de imprensa matinal de rotina. Em 2023, Acapulco sofreu a fúria do furacão Otis, considerado o ciclone tropical mais forte a atingir a costa do Pacífico mexicano. A tempestade, que ocorreu no final de outubro, deixou pelo menos 68 mortes confirmadas, segundo a Procuradoria Geral do Estado de Guerrero, e causou aproximadamente US$16 bilhões em danos, de acordo com estimativas de associações empresariais mexicanas.

item.title: Trump compró y vendió acciones de SpaceX, la empresa de Musk, en julio, según declaración patrimonial
item.description: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, compró en julio acciones por un valor de hasta 50.000 dólares y vendió otras por un valor de hasta 15.000 dólares de SpaceX, la empresa de Elon Musk, según un documento público.
item.dc:creator: Courtney Rozen
item.content:encoded: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, compró en julio acciones por un valor de hasta 50.000 dólares y vendió otras por un valor de hasta 15.000 dólares de SpaceX, la empresa de Elon Musk, según un documento público. Trump compró acciones de SpaceX por un valor de entre 15.001 y 50.000 dólares el 10 de julio, según una declaración financiera que firmó el 8 de septiembre. Vendió acciones por un valor de entre 1.001 y 15.000 dólares el 17 de julio, según la misma declaración. La compra y la venta formaban parte de las más de 1.000 operaciones que el presidente realizó en julio. La Oficina de Ética Gubernamental, el equipo encargado de recopilar las declaraciones de ética de los funcionarios estadounidenses, publicó el formulario en su página web el martes. Estas últimas operaciones añaden un nuevo vínculo financiero entre el presidente y la empresa de cohetes de Musk, en un momento en que la Administración está tomando decisiones que podrían afectar al futuro de la empresa. SpaceX fijó el precio de la mayor salida a bolsa de la historia de Estados Unidos el 12 de junio, valorando al proveedor de servicios espaciales, de satélites e inteligencia artificial en 1,77 billones de dólares. Reuters ya había informado de que Trump compró acciones de SpaceX en junio. El portavoz de Trump no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios. Reuters no pudo determinar de inmediato el importe exacto de la inversión de Trump, ya que los funcionarios federales utilizan rangos para declarar el valor de sus activos en sus formularios de declaración patrimonial. SpaceX es un contratista del ejército estadounidense y, a menudo, solicita autorizaciones a las agencias federales.

item.title: Iraq suspends Iranian flights to Baghdad after US sanctions threat, sources say
item.description: Iraq ordered its civil aviation authority to suspend Iranian flights to Baghdad airport starting Wednesday, two sources told Reuters, after the United States threatened to sanction any airport that services Iranian carriers.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Iraq ordered its civil aviation authority to suspend Iranian flights to Baghdad airport starting Wednesday, two sources told Reuters, after the United States threatened to sanction any airport that services Iranian carriers. US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Monday that all Iranian airlines would be shut down on September 23 by the threat of secondary sanctions on air services providers, seven months into the war between the United States and Iran. The Iraqi government is discussing diverting Iranian Airways flights from Baghdad to Najaf airport, two sources familiar with the matter said. They spoke on condition of anonymity because of the sensitivity of the matter. The suspension of flights will begin Wednesday midnight. Iranian news agency Tasnim said earlier, citing the Iranian Civil Aviation Organization, that flights from Tehran to Baghdad and Muscat have been canceled starting Wednesday and that all the remaining international flights including Istanbul will operate according to schedule. "Iranian travelers are not currently being admitted at the airport in Oman, and consultations regarding this matter are ongoing," a spokesperson for Iran's Civil Aviation Organization told Iran's semi-official ISNA news agency. [USN:S0N43U00Z TEXT:"Bessent"] told CNBC that when Iranian airlines land at an airport, "you cannot provide them with fuel, you cannot provide them with landing services, you cannot sell them tickets, or you will be knocked out of the dollar system."

item.title: De óculos inteligentes a broches com IA, receios sobre privacidade desafiam próxima aposta do setor de tecnologia
item.description: As empresas que apostam em uma era pós-smartphone com dispositivos de IA alimentam temores em relação à privacidade em todo o mundo, sentimento que pode retardar a adoção dessa tecnologia emergente.
item.dc:creator: Aditya Soni, Kenneth Li
item.content:encoded: As empresas que apostam em uma era pós-smartphone com dispositivos de IA alimentam temores em relação à privacidade em todo o mundo, sentimento que pode retardar a adoção dessa tecnologia emergente. A reação contra dispositivos capazes de ver, ouvir e responder ao mundo ao seu redor tem sido mais forte em relação aos óculos Ray-Ban da Meta (META.O) , que popularizaram os óculos inteligentes ao combinar o design moderno da EssilorLuxottica (ESLX.PA) com a IA da gigante das redes sociais, em busca da “superinteligência pessoal”. Os óculos se tornaram um alvo de críticas em meio ao crescente mal-estar em relação aos dispositivos movidos a IA, atraindo o escrutínio de tribunais que analisam ações judiciais sobre privacidade, de usuários que temem gravações secretas e de críticos que alertam para um futuro em que os óculos com IA onipresentes corroam as expectativas de anonimato e consentimento. Estabelecimentos no Reino Unido, incluindo uma das maiores redes de pubs do país, a Wetherspoon (JDW.L) , restringiram o uso desses óculos. A Meta deve apresentar óculos inteligentes sem câmera já nesta quarta-feira, em sua conferência Connect, segundo reportagens, destacando o equilíbrio delicado que as empresas enfrentam ao buscar uma fatia do mercado de smartphones, avaliado em mais de US$600 bilhões. Os fabricantes de dispositivos estão testando uma variedade de formatos para superar essas preocupações, desde óculos e broches até pingentes e gravadores de voz que se prendem magneticamente a um celular, segundo entrevistas da Reuters com quase uma dúzia de executivos de tecnologia, analistas e especialistas jurídicos. Algumas empresas estão obtendo aceitação mais rápida no setor empresarial do que entre os consumidores. O desfecho do debate sobre privacidade poderá moldar um mercado que as empresas de tecnologia veem como a próxima grande plataforma de computação. Se as empresas não conseguirem conquistar a confiança do público, os mesmos recursos que tornam úteis os dispositivos vestíveis com inteligência artificial -- câmeras sempre ligadas, microfones e percepção do ambiente -- correm o risco de se tornar um obstáculo à sua adoção. PARCERIA “Os formatos vencedores serão aqueles que tornarem a interação mais natural, útil e confiável”, disse Jay Kim, vice-presidente executivo da divisão de dispositivos móveis da Samsung (005930.KS) , em entrevista à Reuters em julho. À medida que a IA assume mais tarefas, disse ele, os usuários exigirão sistemas que permaneçam seguros e sob seu controle. A Samsung planeja entrar no mercado de óculos inteligentes ainda neste ano por meio de parcerias com a Gentle Monster e a Warby Parker (WRBY.N) , mas não vê os dispositivos como substitutos dos smartphones. Para algumas startups, no entanto, resolver o problema da privacidade pode ser uma questão de sobrevivência. Em conversa com jornalistas em dezembro, o presidente-executivo da OpenAI, Sam Altman, descreveu sua visão de um dispositivo sempre ligado, capaz de compreender o ambiente ao redor do usuário e saber quando ajudar e quando ficar em silêncio. Ele argumentou que tais produtos precisariam, em última instância, processar dados localmente, em vez de enviar informações continuamente para a nuvem. “Você quer um dispositivo em que possa confiar... que tenha o contexto completo e saiba quando ser útil e quando não ser”, disse ele. “Se um dispositivo vai ficar ouvindo e observando toda a sua vida, a maioria das pessoas não vai querer que isso seja feito em um servidor na nuvem.” Ele acrescentou que o processamento local de IA “pode levar mais alguns anos”, dependendo da rapidez com que a OpenAI consiga ampliar a capacidade de seus processadores. Especialistas afirmam que o principal desafio é que os dispositivos de IA se tornam mais úteis à medida que coletam informações sobre o ambiente ao seu redor. Essas informações podem incluir imagens de pessoas que nunca consentiram em ser filmadas.

item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The International Monetary Fund is moving toward reducing the number of economic health checks it performs for certain countries as part of a broader efficiency push by the lender, Bloomberg News reported on Tuesday, citing people familiar with the matter. There is no formal list of countries that will be subject to the less frequent Article IV discussions, the report said, adding decisions are instead expected to be made on a case-by-case basis and countries can also request fewer consultations, the report said. Reuters could not immediately verify the report.

item.title: Reports: Eagles signing Pro Bowl CB Kenny Moore II
item.description: The Eagles are signing veteran cornerback Kenny Moore II to the practice squad, multiple outlets reported on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Eagles are signing veteran cornerback Kenny Moore II to the practice squad, multiple outlets reported on Tuesday. NFL Network reported that Philadelphia is giving the former Pro Bowl selection a one-year deal worth up to $3 million. The Indianapolis Colts released Moore, 31, on May 7 after failing to find a suitable trade partner. Moore had 21 interceptions, 11.5 sacks and 649 tackles in 132 games (111 starts) for the Colts from 2017-25. He made the Pro Bowl in 2021 and appeared in 14 games (seven starts) last season with one pick and 55 tackles. --Field Level Media

This game will be made up as part of a split doubleheader on Wednesday, with games starting at 1:35 p.m. and 6:35 p.m. ET. Both teams could be eliminated from contention by then. item.title: What is in the US-Greenland-Denmark security deal?
item.description: Here are some key components of the deal, which adds to a 1951 US-Danish pact on Greenland's defence.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The United States, Denmark and Greenland [USN:L6N45E07X TEXT:"signed a security agreement"] on Tuesday aimed at ending months of tension over the Danish self-governing territory after US President Donald Trump's repeated threats to take control of the vast Arctic island. Here are some key components of the deal, which adds to a 1951 US-Danish pact on Greenland's defence, according to a text published by the Danish government. WHAT ARE THE MILITARY ASPECTS OF THE DEAL? The agreement allows the United States to establish two [USN:L1N45D100 TEXT:"new military bases"] — one at Narsarsuaq in southern Greenland and the other at Mestersvig on the east coast — and to expand Pituffik Space Base, currently its only active base on the island. US craft including planes and vessels get flyover, landing and undersea rights in all of Greenland, including territorial waters. The agreement does not specify troop numbers or timelines. HOW DOES THE PACT WORK WITH NATO? The agreement expresses support for a stronger NATO presence in the Arctic, and Denmark commits to further strengthen its own security posture in the region. If Greenland ever become independent, Denmark and Greenland must ensure the new state remains in NATO, applying for membership if necessary. Non-NATO members are barred from having an ongoing military presence in Greenland. WHAT RIGHTS DOES GREENLAND HAVE? The agreement says it respects Greenland's right to self-determination. Under the accord, the US must act in a way that respects Greenlandic society and the Greenlandic way of life. WHAT ARE ECONOMIC ASPECTS OF THE PACT? The agreement does not address US interests or investments into Greenland's mining and resources sector. The deal bars investors from outside NATO member states, NATO partners or the European Union from having control or major influence over sensitive sectors in Greenland. Greenland will screen investments to enforce those rules. WHAT HAPPENS NOW? The parliaments of Greenland and Denmark must approve the agreement before it goes into effect. The pact has no end date and can be amended only by mutual consent.

item.title: Governo Trump suspende inscrições no Obamacare para mais de 760 mil pessoas, alegando fraude
item.description: O governo Trump está suspendendo a inscrição em planos de saúde do Obamacare para mais de 760 mil pessoas que, segundo acredita, foram inscritas de forma fraudulenta, afirmou o vice-presidente JD Vance nesta terça-feira, como parte de uma iniciativa antifraude que, segundo ele, economizaria US$2,2 bilhões do dinheiro dos contribuintes.
item.dc:creator: Bo Erickson, Christy Santhosh
item.content:encoded: O governo Trump está suspendendo a inscrição em planos de saúde do Obamacare para mais de 760 mil pessoas que, segundo acredita, foram inscritas de forma fraudulenta, afirmou o vice-presidente JD Vance nesta terça-feira, como parte de uma iniciativa antifraude que, segundo ele, economizaria US$2,2 bilhões do dinheiro dos contribuintes. O Centro de Serviços de Medicare e Medicaid dos EUA (CMS, na sigla em inglês) cancelou cerca de 315 mil planos no mês passado, alegando documentação de cidadania ou imigração não verificada e suspeitas de inscrições indevidas. A agência proibirá 569 corretores que, segundo acusação do órgão, apresentaram "taxas estatisticamente implausíveis de inscrições para o ano de cobertura de 2026" sem informações obrigatórias dos solicitantes, como o número da Seguridade Social. Os planos, criados pela Lei de Cuidados Acessíveis — marca registrada do presidente democrata Barack Obama —, oferecem subsídios baseados na renda. O presidente republicano Donald Trump tentou, sem sucesso, revogar a lei em seu primeiro mandato e propôs mudanças que tornariam os planos menos abrangentes. Milhões de pessoas cancelaram suas coberturas este ano, pois o aumento dos custos médicos e o término dos subsídios extras da era da Covid tornaram os prêmios mensais inacessíveis. Vance descreveu o grupo cancelado como “uma mistura tanto de pessoas fictícias quanto de pessoas reais que simplesmente não atendem aos requisitos de elegibilidade”, incluindo algumas que, segundo ele, foram inscritas por corretores sem o seu conhecimento. Vance afirmou que o governo verificará ainda mais entre 419 mil e 450 mil pessoas para confirmar se são residentes legais nos EUA que atendem aos limites de renda. O administrador do CMS, Mehmet Oz, disse que os inscritos foram tratados como “fantasmas” porque as autoridades acreditam que a maioria deles não existe ou não sabia que tinha cobertura, já que nunca apresentou um pedido de reembolso e não pôde ser contatada, apesar das repetidas tentativas de contato. CONGELAMENTO DO REGISTRO DE CORRETORES O governo está utilizando um processo regulatório de caráter emergencial para impor um congelamento imediato, em todo o setor, de novos registros de corretores do Obamacare, contornando o habitual período de notificação prévia e consulta pública. Oz chamou isso de “moratória nacional temporária” por seis meses, afirmando que a maior parte das fraudes se concentrava entre esses agentes. O CMS afirmou que alguns corretores supostamente inscreveram pessoas sem consentimento genuíno, alteraram os planos das pessoas sem permissão, utilizaram informações imprecisas ou criaram solicitações questionáveis para receber comissões. A agência informou que os corretores sem registro válido para 2026 terão suas atividades suspensas até 1º de fevereiro de 2027. O congelamento pode pesar sobre as seguradoras que dependem dos corretores para captar clientes, segundo analistas. Como os corretores são fundamentais para o processo de inscrição das pessoas, a suspensão “pode afetar negativamente as inscrições e, potencialmente, as margens relacionadas a um grupo de risco mais elevado em um mercado que já está em contração”, à medida que os subsídios ampliados expiram, afirmou a analista da Morningstar, Julie Utterback. Uma moratória generalizada “puniria profissionais legítimos em vez de visar os malfeitores responsáveis por fraudes”, disse Mychal Walker, presidente da Associação Nacional de Profissionais de Benefícios e Seguros, um grupo setorial que instou o CMS a adotar, em vez disso, medidas de proteção direcionadas. O CMS afirmou que as inscrições não autorizadas no Obamacare poderiam custar até US$6,6 bilhões em gastos federais indevidos para o ano de cobertura de 2026. Os cancelamentos foram liderados pela força-tarefa antifraude de Vance, que inclui o secretário de Saúde, Robert F. Kennedy Jr., Oz e o presidente da Comissão Federal de Comércio, Andrew Ferguson.

item.title: Trump bought and sold shares in Musk's SpaceX in July, financial disclosure shows
item.description: US President Donald Trump bought as much as $50,000 worth of shares and sold as much as $15,000 in Elon Musk's SpaceX in July, according to a public financial disclosure, his latest transactions involving a government contractor run by his former adviser.
item.dc:creator: Courtney Rozen
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump bought as much as $50,000 worth of shares and sold as much as $15,000 in Elon Musk's SpaceX in July, according to a public financial disclosure, his latest transactions involving a government contractor run by his former adviser. Trump bought between $15,001 and $50,000 worth of shares in SpaceX on July 10, according to a financial disclosure he signed on September 8. He sold between $1,001 and $15,000 worth of shares on July 17, according to the same disclosure. The latest trades add a new financial link between the president and Musk's rocket company at a time when the administration is making decisions that could affect the firm's fortunes. SpaceX priced the [USN:L6N42G18Z TEXT:"biggest-ever US IPO"] on June 12, valuing the space, satellite and AI provider at $1.77 trillion. Reuters previously reported that [USN:L6N44L0U6 TEXT:"Trump bought shares in SpaceX"] in June. In a statement to Reuters at the time, White House spokesman Davis Ingle said third-party financial institutions independently manage the president's portfolio and replicate "recognized indexes, such as the Schwab 1000." Trump's spokesperson did not immediately respond to a request for comment about the July trades. The purchase and sale were among more than 1,000 trades the president made in July. The Office of Government Ethics, the team responsible for collecting ethics disclosures from US officials, posted the form on its website on Tuesday. Reuters could not immediately determine the precise amount of Trump's investment because federal officials use ranges to declare the value of their assets on their financial disclosure forms. SpaceX is a US military [USN:L1N3P10ZT TEXT:"contractor,"] and often seeks [USN:L1N43U12L TEXT:"approvals"] from federal agencies.

item.title: IMF to help Ukraine find some funds for next year, Zelenskiy says
item.description: The International Monetary Fund will help Ukraine find part of the funding it needs to maintain financial and economic stability next year, President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said on Tuesday after meeting IMF head Kristalina Georgieva.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The International Monetary Fund will help Ukraine find part of the funding it needs to maintain financial and economic stability next year, President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said on Tuesday after meeting IMF head Kristalina Georgieva. With the war against Russia in its fifth year, securing financing for 2026 and 2027 remains a key challenge for Ukraine. The country needs about $52.6 billion in international financial aid for next year, officials said. "The Russians are trying not only to destroy life itself, but also to disrupt the functioning of businesses and the state as much as possible. That is why macrofinancial assistance is especially important for us right now," Zelenskiy said on the Telegram app, posting a video of his meeting with Georgieva.

item.title: Barkin, de la Fed, dice que moderar expectativas de las empresas sobre la inflación puede aliviar presiones sobre precios
item.description: Las subidas de tasas de interés de la Fed y la amenaza de que se produzcan más podrían moderar las expectativas de inflación de las empresas y frenar los aumentos de precios mientras éstas negocian los presupuestos para el próximo año, afirmó el martes el presidente de la Fed de Richmond, Tom Barkin, señalando una forma de mitigar la inflación sin ralentizar la economía.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Las subidas de tasas de interés de la Fed y la amenaza de que se produzcan más podrían moderar las expectativas de inflación de las empresas y frenar los aumentos de precios mientras éstas negocian los presupuestos para el próximo año, afirmó el martes el presidente de la Fed de Richmond, Tom Barkin, señalando una forma de mitigar la inflación sin ralentizar la economía. Mientras las empresas deliberan sobre sus estrategias de precios, "un punto de referencia importante en esa lucha son las expectativas sobre cuál será la inflación el año que viene", afirmó Barkin en declaraciones a los periodistas durante un evento de la CFA. "Si se espera que la inflación sea más alta, se fijan precios más altos. Si se espera que la inflación sea más baja, se fijan precios más bajos".

item.title: ExxonMobil quer fazer parte do "próximo capítulo" do petróleo no Brasil, diz executivo
item.description: A petroleira norte-americana ExxonMobil quer fazer parte do próximo ciclo de desenvolvimento da indústria de petróleo e gás do Brasil, o que inclui a Margem Equatorial, disse o vice-presidente sênior de Águas Profundas da companhia, Hunter Farris, nesta terça-feira.
item.dc:creator: Marta Nogueira
item.content:encoded: A petroleira norte-americana ExxonMobil (XOM.N) quer fazer parte do próximo ciclo de desenvolvimento da indústria de petróleo e gás do Brasil, o que inclui a Margem Equatorial, disse o vice-presidente sênior de Águas Profundas da companhia, Hunter Farris, nesta terça-feira. No ano passado, a Exxon arrematou em parceria com a Petrobras dez blocos exploratórios na Bacia da Foz do Amazonas, situada na Margem Equatorial, onde a indústria acredita estar a nova fronteira exploratória mais promissora do Brasil. "É uma ótima vizinhança", disse Farris, ao ser questionado sobre a Margem Equatorial, que inclui blocos exploratórios com geologia semelhante à da Guiana, onde a produção da companhia tem crescido. O comentário foi feito durante o congresso de óleo e gás no Rio de Janeiro ROG.e. "Quando pensamos no Brasil, vemos o sucesso extraordinário que o país conseguiu alcançar, e queremos fazer parte do próximo capítulo que será escrito no Brasil", afirmou ele. O executivo não detalhou, porém, eventuais planos de investimento ou de exploração da Exxon na Margem Equatorial. Mas defendeu que empresas com capacidade para explorar novas fronteiras continuem buscando novas reservas, diante da importância que atribui ao petróleo e ao gás para a segurança energética global. "Há muita gente nos observando. O mundo nos observa porque precisa de nós. Alguns nos amam, alguns nos odeiam", disse Farris. Na visão do executivo, a indústria tem a oportunidade de explorar e desenvolver novos recursos de forma responsável e eficiente, contribuindo para a segurança energética e, ao mesmo tempo, gerando empregos e riqueza nos países produtores. Ele disse esperar que, daqui a dez anos, o Atlântico Sul tenha registrado novas descobertas e colocado novos projetos em desenvolvimento. GUIANA Farris citou a experiência da companhia na Guiana, onde a Exxon liderou uma série de grandes descobertas a partir de 2015 que transformaram o país em um importante produtor de petróleo, como exemplo da importância de explorar novas fronteiras. Segundo ele, antes da descoberta de Liza, em maio de 2015, mais de 40 poços haviam sido perfurados no offshore da Guiana sem sucesso. A Exxon, no entanto, apostou em sua experiência acumulada na margem atlântica, especialmente na África Ocidental, além de tecnologia e dados para avançar na região. Atualmente, disse Farris, quatro projetos estão em operação na Guiana, com produção de cerca de 900 mil barris por dia, enquanto um quinto FPSO está sendo conectado e comissionado. A expectativa é que a produção supere 1 milhão de barris por dia até o final do ano. Ao comparar com a experiência da Guiana, Farris afirmou que o Brasil fez um trabalho extraordinário para chegar à posição que ocupa hoje na indústria, mas ressaltou que a velocidade é um elemento importante para transformar descobertas em produção e geração de valor. "Velocidade importa", afirmou.

item.title: Trump supports diesel export ban as fuel prices hit records
item.description: US President Donald Trump said on Tuesday he backed the idea of a ban on diesel exports, which lawmakers from farm states are calling for as a way to curb the soaring cost of energy.
item.dc:creator: Gram Slattery, Ryan Patrick Jones, Timothy Gardner
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump said on Tuesday he backed the idea of a ban on diesel exports, which lawmakers from farm states are calling for as a way to curb the soaring cost of energy. Diesel prices have shot to [USN:L6N4580TA TEXT:"record highs"] in the US and Europe as wars in Iran and Ukraine sharply cut exports from some of the biggest producers such as Russia, Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates. "I've said let's not send out the diesel. We make a lot of diesel ... I've called for it. I've called for it within my people," Trump told reporters ahead of a meeting with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy. High fuel prices are a vulnerability for Trump in the November 3 midterm elections in which his fellow Republicans are trying to maintain majorities in both chambers of Congress. US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, speaking at the same meeting, said the administration was examining whether such a ban was feasible and whether a full or partial ban would work. The comments come after pressure from Republican US Senator Chuck Grassley of Iowa who said on X last week that "High diesel prices are KILLING FARMERS INCOME." Trump's backing of a diesel export ban puts him at odds with his own top energy officials, who warn it could raise fuel prices on the coasts and tighten supplies for European allies. ENERGY OFFICIALS WARN OF RISKS Energy Secretary Chris Wright told a Daily Caller event last week that such a ban would lead to a glut of the product in the US Gulf Coast and prompt US refiners to cut production rates, which would quickly reduce gasoline production. "If you start putting barriers on flows, pretty quickly you will reduce the production, and you'll have less supply. We need more supply, not less supply," Wright said. Doug Burgum, the US Interior Secretary, said a ban would be unlikely to lower petroleum prices and could lead to [USN:L1N4560TC TEXT:"retaliatory"] measures by energy exporting countries, which states like California rely on for some of their energy. While a diesel export ban could, in theory, temporarily lower prices on the US Gulf Coast, it would tighten supplies further in Europe, which is structurally short on diesel and relies heavily on US exports. "That would seem pretty damaging to some key U.S. allies," said Jim Mitchell, director of oil trading analytics at consultancy Wood Mackenzie. Trump said he and Zelenskiy would discuss Ukrainian attacks on oil refineries in Russia. "It is a serious hit on the Russians. It's also a serious hit on the price of diesel," said Trump, who also told reporters the two leaders would discuss working out a solution to end Russia's war in Ukraine. "I think it's going to happen," Trump said.

item.title: OpenAI amplia linha GPT-6 com modelos Sol e Luna mais acessíveis
item.description: A OpenAI ampliou nesta terça-feira sua linha de inteligência artificial GPT-6 com dois modelos cujos preços correspondem à metade das tarifas promocionais de seus antecessores, ao mesmo tempo em que oferecem alguns dos recursos do modelo principal da companhia, o Astra.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A OpenAI ampliou nesta terça-feira sua linha de inteligência artificial GPT-6 com dois modelos cujos preços correspondem à metade das tarifas promocionais de seus antecessores, ao mesmo tempo em que oferecem alguns dos recursos do modelo principal da companhia, o Astra. O lançamento dos modelos de baixo custo GPT-6 Sol e GPT-6 Luna segue a introdução do GPT-6 Astra, um modelo mais rápido para lidar com mais tarefas do que as versões anteriores, no início deste mês. O GPT-6 Sol custará US$2 por milhão de tokens de entrada e US$10 por milhão de tokens de saída, uma redução de 50% em relação aos preços promocionais do GPT-5.6 Sol, enquanto o GPT-6 Luna custará US$0,10 por milhão de tokens de entrada e US$0,50 por milhão de tokens de saída. A OpenAI também alertou que o Astra pode, às vezes, tentar escapar do monitoramento humano. Embora o Astra continue sendo seu modelo mais capaz para projetos exigentes, o GPT-6 Sol e o Luna foram projetados para oferecer opções de menor custo para trabalhos profissionais, programação, automação e tarefas de uso de computador, informou a empresa. A OpenAI informou que treinou o Sol e o Luna utilizando métodos semelhantes aos empregados para o Astra, incluindo melhorias em raciocínio, confiabilidade factual, programação, uso de computadores e alinhamento. “Melhorias no cache e na inferência nos permitem oferecer esses modelos a um custo menor, e estamos repassando essa economia diretamente aos usuários e clientes”, afirmou a empresa. (Por Harshita Mary Varghese)

item.title: GRANOS Futuros de la soja cotizan estables a la espera de la cumbre entre EEUU y China
item.description: Los futuros de soja de la Bolsa de Chicago (CBOT) se mantenían prácticamente sin cambios el martes, mientras los operadores esperaban a ver si la cumbre entre Estados Unidos y China de esta semana impulsa la demanda de productos agrícolas.
item.dc:creator: Tom Polansek
item.content:encoded: Los futuros de soja de la Bolsa de Chicago (CBOT) se mantenían prácticamente sin cambios el martes, mientras los operadores esperaban a ver si la cumbre entre Estados Unidos y China de esta semana impulsa la demanda de productos agrícolas. El mercado se tomó un respiro tras el repunte del lunes, impulsado por las esperanzas de que se alcancen acuerdos agrícolas entre Washington y Pekín, el mayor importador mundial de soja, en la reunión prevista para el jueves entre los presidentes Donald Trump y Xi Jinping. Los operadores quieren ver si China accede a realizar compras y a eliminar el arancel del 10% a la soja estadounidense. "Estamos a la espera de ver qué sale de la reunión", dijo Don Roose, presidente de la correduría U.S. Commodities. Los futuros de soja subían 0,5 centavos, a 13,285 dólares el bushel, a las 1740 GMT. El contrato referencial se había acercado antes a un máximo de casi tres años, de 13,3525 dólares, alcanzado el 11 de septiembre, antes de recortar ganancias. El contrato de maíz de la CBOT bajaba 4,25 centavos, a 5,3875 dólares el bushel, mientras que el de trigo caía 6 centavos, a 7,2075 dólares el bushel. Los agricultores avanzaban en las cosechas de soja y maíz en el Medio Oeste de Estados Unidos, trayendo nuevos suministros de sus campos. Tras el cierre de la sesión del lunes, el Departamento de Agricultura informó de que, al domingo, la cosecha de maíz estaba completa en un 13% y la de soja en un 12%, por delante de sus promedios de los últimos cinco años. Los operadores se mantuvieron atentos a la previsión meteorológica debido a la preocupación de que la lluvia ralentice las cosechas en algunas zonas. "Simplemente sigue siendo un tiempo que no favorece una cosecha rápida", dijo Roose. Los futuros del trigo se vieron sometidos a presión por los esfuerzos diplomáticos para rebajar la tensión en la guerra de Rusia con Ucrania, que ha paralizado las exportaciones de cereales del mar Negro procedentes de ambos países, según los operadores.
